title: S02T02 - Implement safe execution policy for declared verification gates
description: Promote the execute-at-close proposal into a bounded, opt-in policy that runs only filer-declared commands with explicit cwd, time, output, environment, and permission limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Untrusted work text cannot become executable command text; only policy-approved declared gates can run.
Execution enforces timeout, output bounds, cwd boundaries, environment redaction, cancellation, and dry-run preview.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.

dirtyPathNotes: git_unavailable: declared-gate runner, bounded-process cancellation, tests, docs, and tracker state remain uncommitted because the managed session denies creation of .git/index.lock

closedReason: Untrusted work text cannot execute; approved gate commands now have a bounded, previewable, cancellable, workspace-confined execution policy.
